runtime: uv-managed Python 3.12.14 в .venv (uv sync --group dev); системный /usr/bin/python3 (3.9.6) НЕ используется и не поддерживается — код использует синтаксис 3.10+ (X | Y); зависимости: FastAPI, uvicorn, python-multipart, openpyxl, xlrd, PyYAML из pyproject.toml/uv.lock; stdlib sqlite3 local transactional store; browser vanilla JS

parser_api.inspect_file(path): JSON dict {format, sheets:[{name, rows, cols, preview:[{row,cells:[{col,value,coordinate,hidden,formula}]}], candidates:[tableSpec], fingerprint}], warnings:[]}; unknown formats/encryption raise ValueError with safe reason. Candidate is suggestion, never automatic profile creation.
parser_api.parse_file(path, profile, limit=None): JSON dict {items:[], quarantine:[], dropped:[], counts:{source_rows,accepted_rows,quarantined_rows,dropped_rows,items}, status:accepted|quarantine, reason:null|string}. Monetary values decimal strings, no NaN. limit limits source data rows globally, not output items.
parser_api.fingerprint(path, profile): str stable SHA256 of approved sheet/table header geometry/values, merge shape excluding filename/sheet name and variable data length. Different A/B/V07 distinct. Missing header raises ValueError. Profile data_start/end bounds not count fingerprint.

web_api.POST /api/upload: multipart files, source optional; returns {results:[{file_id,status,reason,shipment_id?}]} auto-parse only exact one approved matching fingerprint, otherwise review; dedup does not activate current
web_api.POST /api/files/{id}/preview: JSON profile object; parse first 100 source rows, return parse result plus fingerprint; no writes to profiles/shipments
web_api.POST /api/files/{id}/approve: JSON profile object; preview validation then complete parse BEFORE atomic profile revision+shipment+current; failed dry run no revision. Explicit ingest_mode required. Return parse counts/status/profile_id/shipment_id
web_api.POST /api/files/{id}/reprocess: JSON {profile_id}; creates new immutable shipment only through explicit action, increments processing generation
web_api.GET /api/jobs: {jobs:[{id,file_id,state,owner_pid,attempts,result,error,created_at,updated_at}]} — долговечный журнал явных импортов; ретрай того же задания повторяет сохранённый payload, исправление входа = новое задание
web_api.GET /api/profiles/{id}/yaml?revision=: YAML-дамп точной ревизии профиля (body + id + revision), Content-Disposition attachment

ownership.backend: aggregator/app.py, aggregator/storage.py, aggregator/__init__.py, aggregator/__main__.py, pyproject.toml, tests/test_storage.py
ownership.integration: Main owns cross-module integration, acceptance test runs, existing documentation updates

security: Bind loopback default; no remote URL fetching; cap upload/decompressed bytes/cells; no macro execution; local JS only; no innerHTML from workbook data; immutable raw CAS; no filename paths; profile evidence quotes validated; unsupported modules clearly shown disabled rather than fake implementations
workflow: All worker agents skip formatter/linter/build/test execution during concurrent edits. Do not edit fixtures, manifests, generators or .omp. No new documentation files; Main updates existing doc. Tell peers before changing contract. Actual behaviors, no placeholders or fake noops.
